value: Research dataset for Q-Cash revenue forecasting and early-revenue-access limit experiments.
Belgard Barbers transaction statement supplied for this project.
Only M-Pesa Till Payment Received credits are treated as operating revenue. Other bank credits are retained only in source-quality checks.
Customer names, raw phone numbers, account/till numbers, balances and free-text statement details are excluded. Customer hashes are one-way pseudonyms.
target_next_30d_revenue_kes: revenue in the 30 calendar days after as_of_date.
Rolling 7/14/30/60/90-day behavioral features are calculated using information available on or before as_of_date.
Monthly national CPI and headline inflation from KNBS are joined by month. They are contextual features, not invented business transactions.
No synthetic transactions are mixed into the observed dataset. Synthetic augmentation should be a separate experiment and must be labelled synthetic.
One business is not sufficient to claim general MSME performance. It is sufficient to build and test the pipeline, feature engineering and time-series methodology.
Use chronological/walk-forward splits; never randomly shuffle time-dependent observations. Keep the final period as a holdout.
